absher.title: Absher Platform
absher.subtitle: The Ministry of Interior's gateway to digital services.
absher.intro: Absher is the Ministry of Interior's e-services platform. It lets citizens, residents, businesses, and government entities complete procedures online that once required a visit to a government office.

digital_identity.title: Digital Identity
digital_identity.subtitle: One verified identity across government and private services.
digital_identity.intro: A digital identity lets a person prove who they are online without visiting an office. In Saudi Arabia the Ministry of Interior issues unified digital IDs through Absher, and the same identity can be used to sign in to other platforms through the national unified access service, Nafath.

items.label: Unified digital IDs issued through Absher

items.title: Ministry of Interior: Absher
items.text: Issues unified digital IDs through Absher. A digital ID opens the Ministry's own services and can also be used to connect to government or private platforms.

items.title: SDAIA: Nafath
items.text: Nafath is the national unified access service for signing in to government and private platforms. It is developed and run by the Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA), not by the Ministry of Interior.

digital_services.title: Digital Services
digital_services.subtitle: Procedures that moved from the counter to the screen.
digital_services.intro: Absher brings together services from across the Ministry of Interior's sectors, and new services are added regularly. The examples below are recent additions announced by the Ministry.

items.label: Ministry of Interior sectors served by Absher

items.title: Public Security
items.text: New services on Absher Individuals include transferring vehicle ownership to businesses and added features for air rifle permits, such as ownership transfer and license renewal.

items.title: Civil Affairs
items.text: New digital civil affairs services let users amend the information on birth certificates and death certificates.
